description_target.target_text: The first panel is the source and the second is the target. For each candidate, compute which cells would survive a symmetric-difference operation with the source. The correct candidate is the one whose XOR pattern matches the target exactly; output that candidate’s shape in cyan(8).

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))

    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (render-same-size cells h w [color 8])
      (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0)
                   (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)) cells)
                   color))
    (define (panel-occ panel)
      (sort (filter (lambda (p)
                      (let ((v (at panel (first p) (second p))))
                        (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 9)))))
                    (grid-positions panel))
            cell<))
    (define (panel-color panel)
      (let ((vals (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 9))))
                          (flatmap (lambda (r) (row panel r)) (range 0 (rows panel))))))
        (if (empty? vals) 0 (first vals))))
    (define (recolor-panel panel [color 8])
      (render-same-size (panel-occ panel) (rows panel) (cols panel) color))
    (define (split-cols-9 grid)
      (let loop ([c 0] [start 0] [acc (list)])
        (cond [(>= c (cols grid))
               (reverse (if (< start (cols grid))
                            (cons (subgrid grid 0 start (- (rows grid) 1) (- (cols grid) 1)) acc)
                            acc))]
              [(all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c) 9)) (range 0 (rows grid)))
               (let scan ([cc c])
                 (if (and (< cc (cols grid))
                          (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r cc) 9)) (range 0 (rows grid))))
                     (scan (+ cc 1))
                     (loop cc cc
                           (if (< start c)
                               (cons (subgrid grid 0 start (- (rows grid) 1) (- c 1)) acc)
                               acc))))]
              [else (loop (+ c 1) start acc)])))
    (define (split-rows-9 grid)
      (let loop ([r 0] [start 0] [acc (list)])
        (cond [(>= r (rows grid))
               (reverse (if (< start (rows grid))
                            (cons (subgrid grid start 0 (- (rows grid) 1) (- (cols grid) 1)) acc)
                            acc))]
              [(all? (lambda (c) (= (at grid r c) 9)) (range 0 (cols grid)))
               (let scan ([rr r])
                 (if (and (< rr (rows grid))
                          (all? (lambda (c) (= (at grid rr c) 9)) (range 0 (cols grid))))
                     (scan (+ rr 1))
                     (loop rr rr
                           (if (< start r)
                               (cons (subgrid grid start 0 (- r 1) (- (cols grid) 1)) acc)
                               acc))))]
              [else (loop (+ r 1) start acc)])))
    (define (union-cells panels)
      (sort (remove-duplicates (flatmap panel-occ panels)) cell<))
    (define (inter-cells a b)
      (let ((bb (panel-occ b)))
        (filter (lambda (p) (member? p bb)) (panel-occ a))))
    (define (minus-cells a b)
      (let ((bb (panel-occ b)))
        (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p bb))) (panel-occ a))))
    (define (xor-cells a b)
      (append (minus-cells a b) (minus-cells b a)))
    (define (normalize-cells cells)
      (if (empty? cells)
          (list)
          (let* ((r0 (apply min (map first cells)))
                 (c0 (apply min (map second cells))))
            (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0))) cells) cell<))))
    (define (rotate-cells cells)
      (let* ((norm (normalize-cells cells)))
        (if (empty? norm)
            norm
            (let ((h (+ 1 (apply max (map first norm)))))
              (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- h 1 (first p)))) norm))))))
    (define (rotate-times-cells cells k)
      (let loop ([cur cells] [n (modulo k 4)])
        (if (= n 0) (normalize-cells cur) (loop (rotate-cells cur) (- n 1)))))
    (define (reflect-h-cells cells)
      (let* ((norm (normalize-cells cells)))
        (if (empty? norm)
            norm
            (let ((w (+ 1 (apply max (map second norm)))))
              (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- w 1 (second p)))) norm))))))
    (define (dihedral-variants cells)
      (remove-duplicates
       (flatmap (lambda (k)
                  (let ((rot (rotate-times-cells cells k)))
                    (list (normalize-cells rot) (normalize-cells (reflect-h-cells rot)))))
                (range 0 4))))
    (define (majority-cells panels k)
      (let ((cells (remove-duplicates (flatmap panel-occ panels))))
        (filter (lambda (p) (>= (count-where (lambda (panel) (member? p (panel-occ panel))) panels) k)) cells)))
    (define (op-from-header header)
      (let ((cells (panel-occ header)))
        (cond [(member? (list 0 0) cells) 1]
              [(member? (list 0 (- (cols header) 1)) cells) 2]
              [(member? (list (- (rows header) 1) 0) cells) 3]
              [else 4])))
    (define (stamp-template template-panel markers-panel)
      (let* ((template (panel-occ template-panel))
             (offsets (normalize-cells template))
             (h (rows markers-panel))
             (w (cols markers-panel))
             (anchors (filter (lambda (p) (= (at markers-panel (first p) (second p)) 3))
                              (grid-positions markers-panel)))
             (cells (remove-duplicates
                     (flatmap (lambda (anchor)
                                (map (lambda (off) (list (+ (first anchor) (first off))
                                                         (+ (second anchor) (second off))))
                                     offsets))
                              anchors))))
        (render-same-size cells h w 8)))
    (define (identify-transform a b)
      (let ((target (normalize-cells (panel-occ b)))
            (src (panel-occ a)))
        (let loop ([k 0])
          (cond [(= k 4)
                 (if (equal? (normalize-cells (reflect-h-cells src)) target) 4 0)]
                [(equal? (normalize-cells (rotate-times-cells src k)) target) k]
                [else (loop (+ k 1))]))))
    (define (apply-cell-transform cells code)
      (if (= code 4) (reflect-h-cells cells) (rotate-times-cells cells code)))
    (define (without-last xs)
      (if (empty? (rest xs)) (list) (cons (first xs) (without-last (rest xs)))))
    (define (pair-up xs)
      (if (empty? xs) (list) (cons (list (first xs) (second xs)) (pair-up (rest (rest xs))))))

    (let* ((panels (split-cols-9 g))
           (src (first panels))
           (target (second panels))
           (cands (rest (rest panels)))
           (src-occ (panel-occ src))
           (target-occ (panel-occ target))
           (chosen (find-first (lambda (p)
                                 (equal? (sort (append (filter (lambda (q) (not (member? q (panel-occ p)))) src-occ)
                                                       (filter (lambda (q) (not (member? q src-occ))) (panel-occ p)))
                                             cell<)
                                         target-occ))
                               cands)))
      (if (eq? chosen #f) (empty-grid (rows (first cands)) (cols (first cands)) 0) (recolor-panel chosen 8)))
  ))
